reden: Yes. The audit report’s [High] finding on AuctionDemo precisely matches the described issue: both claimAuction() and cancelBid() are callable when block.timestamp == auctionEndTime due to <= and >= checks, and claimAuction refunds losing bids without setting their status to false. This enables a bidder to obtain double refunds (via claimAuction and then cancelBid), potentially draining the contract. The code path (AuctionDemo.claimAuction/cancelBid), the underlying mechanism (time-boundary overlap + missing status update on refunds), and the concrete fix (use strict inequality and mark bids as paid/refunded) are the same. An attack that works in the description would work against the issue identified in the audit and vice versa.
